notes.title: DEVLOG #4 – Escape Vehicle: The School Bus
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’re introducing a new interactive escape feature currently in development: the school bus. This isn’t just another background element. It’s being built as a fully usable escape vehicle in Night of the Slayers.

The bus is designed as a team-focused alternative escape option. With two working doors, a fully walkable interior, and a heavier driving feel, it offers a different experience compared to other vehicles. Players will need to locate fuel and a missing wheel to get it running.

Once operational, the bus can break through a secured exit barrier. It’s not built for risky solo plays. Instead, it’s meant to support a more cooperative and fun experience, helping the team move together and stand stronger against the hunter.

notes.title: DEVLOG #3 – Lobby Mini-Game: Raccoon Runner
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

While our main focus remains on developing the core gameplay, we’ve added a small feature to improve the lobby experience: Raccoon Runner, a lightweight mini-game that helps pass the time while waiting for other players.

What you can try right now:

Jump using mouse click, Spacebar, or the Up Arrow key

High-score tracking

Retro 8-bit style visuals

Collapsible window inside the lobby UI

We’re currently improving the panel’s toggle behavior and general UI transitions. Final layout may change slightly based on your feedback.

notes.title: DEVLOG #2 – Multiplayer Lobby System Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We hope you're doing well. We're excited to introduce a set of major improvements to the multiplayer lobby system in Night of the Slayers.

With our new Region Manager and custom server list interface, players can now manually select their preferred region and browse available game rooms through a responsive, in-game UI. The system also includes various filtering options such as region-based sorting, ping display, and room availability indicators.

This update is powered by Photon PUN’s global infrastructure, which ensures better latency and more stable matchmaking across all supported regions.

You now have greater control over how you connect to matches, making it easier to team up with nearby players and enjoy smoother co-op sessions.

As always, we welcome your feedback on our Steam forums or Discord server.

notes.title: DEVLOG #1 – Dynamic Weather System
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We hope you are doing well. We are pleased to introduce our Dynamic Weather System for Night of the Slayers. This new feature includes:

Real-time rain particle effects

Volumetric cloud animations

Randomized lightning strikes with synchronized thunder

Every match will now deliver its own unique horror atmosphere. The demo is not live yet, but we welcome your feedback on our Steam forums or via Discord.
